_readme: Quantities for the original 10 machines come directly from the company's own profile document (M.J. Oswal Exports Pvt. Ltd.). The stitching, cutting and quality entries added afterwards to round out real departments the profile didn't itemise use qualitative descriptions rather than invented counts — replace the '[Add verified count]' wording with real figures once confirmed. To add a new machine: copy one object inside 'items', keep every key, add an image under /assets/images/machines/ (or reuse a real photo already in the project), and re-run scripts/build_site.py.

items.name: Circular Knitting Machines
items.description: High-speed, computerised machines for consistent fabric quality and output.
items.details: 20 circular knitting machines (plus 2 interlock knitting machines) form the core of our in-house fabric production.

items.name: Interlock Knitting Machines
items.description: Dedicated interlock machines running alongside our circular knitting line.
items.details: 2 interlock knitting machines, high-speed and computerised for consistent fabric quality and output.

items.name: Flat Knitting Machines
items.description: Specialised machines for ribs, collars and finer knit structures.
items.details: 4 flat knitting machines for specialised fabrics, built for precision and versatility.

items.name: Automatic Screen Printing Machines
items.description: Rotary automatic presses for high-volume, multicolour garment printing.
items.details: 11 automatic screen printing machines, supporting up to 7-8 colours per print run.

items.name: Manual Printing Machine
items.description: Hand-operated carousel press for smaller runs and sample development.
items.details: 1 manual printing machine, used alongside our automatic lines for shorter runs and sampling.

items.name: Gas Curing Machines
items.description: Curing tunnels that set printed ink for durability and wash-fastness.
items.details: 2 gas curing machines, ensuring proper curing for long-lasting prints.

items.name: Fusing Machines
items.description: Heat-press units for tagless labels, patches and appliqué work.
items.details: 4 fusing machines used for heat labels, stickers and patches.

items.name: Multi-Head Embroidery Machines
items.description: Computerised multi-head machines for high-speed, detailed embroidery.
items.details: Multi-head embroidery machines running everything from small logos to detailed multicolour patterns.

items.name: Fabric Cutting Machine
items.description: Hand-guided round-knife cutters for shorter runs and irregular panels.
items.details: Used for smaller cutting runs and panel shapes that don't need a full automatic lay. [Add verified count.]

items.name: Automatic Fabric Cutting Machine
items.description: Computerised cutter for high-volume, high-precision fabric lays.
items.details: Cuts multiple fabric layers in one pass against the digital pattern, for consistent panel sizing on bulk orders. [Add verified count.]

items.name: Laser Cutting Machine
items.description: Precision laser cutting for clean edges on printed and value-added fabric.
items.details: 1 laser cutting machine for accurate, clean cutting of printed fabric.

items.name: Plotter Machine
items.description: Large-format plotter for pattern markers and design handling.
items.details: 1 plotter machine for precise pattern plotting and marker layout ahead of cutting.

items.name: Single Needle Lockstitch Machines
items.description: The core stitching line — single-needle machines running the main seams on every garment.
items.details: Our main stitching floor, where the bulk of every garment's construction happens seam by seam. [Add verified count.]

items.name: Collar & Cuff Machine
items.description: A specialised attachment machine dedicated to collars and cuffs.
items.details: Runs only collar and cuff attachment, so that detail gets a dedicated machine and operator rather than sharing time on the main line. [Add verified count.]

items.name: Drawstring Inserting Machine
items.description: Feeds and stitches drawcords and elastic through waistbands and hoods.
items.details: Used for waistband drawcords and hood strings across our track suits and lounge wear. [Add verified count.]

items.name: Quality Testing Lab
items.description: In-house inspection point where fabric and finished garments are checked against AQL standards.
items.details: Fabric rolls and finished garments are checked here against our AQL standard before they move to the next stage. [Add verified count/equipment list.]
